definitions.explanation: A chronic sleep disorder characterized by difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or getting quality sleep.

notes:
{不眠症|ふみんしょう} is the medical term for insomnia. {不|ふ} (not) + {眠|みん} (sleep) + {症|しょう} (condition).
